paragraphs: Abba Chalifa Keroya asked R. Chiyya bar Abba: Bava Batra 123a. Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of chapter 4 of Maaser Sheni: “Abba bar Chilfai bar Keroyi taught, etc.; R. Chiyya bar Va was in Rome, etc.; the one who instructed us, Chalfi bar Keroyi.”
